key.answer_key: No. The Tauc lines drawn for the doped samples run through the sub-edge tail region (hv ~2.3-2.9), which carries the Er line near 2.37 eV, rather than through the main absorption edge near 3 eV, so the fitted lines are not reading the TiO2 band edge the claim describes.
